scenes.headline: How a 230M model plays chess one token per move
scenes.sub: ChessLFM: a closed move vocabulary, a value token, and a small search.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Zigzag! ChessLFM turns a small language model into a chess engine. Here's how it reads a board and picks a move.

scenes.text: Every geometrically possible move is one vocabulary token, 1,968 in all. The model reads a fixed 80-token board and answers with one.
scenes.say: The idea: every possible move is a single token, nineteen hundred and sixty-eight in all. The model reads a fixed eighty-token board, and answers with one.

steps.say: The board goes in as eighty tokens: sixty-four squares, some state, and the last eight moves. Every field has a fixed place.
Pass one emits a value token: how good the position is, as one of sixty-four bins.
That token is appended, and pass two scores every one of the move tokens.
The host masks out illegal moves, and the best legal one is played.

scenes.label: of positions where the unmasked model's top pick was already legal
scenes.note: 1,700 positions; the mask fires about once every 280 moves
scenes.say: How much does that mask do? With it removed, the top pick was legal ninety-nine point six five percent of the time. The encoding learned legality.

items.say: For strength, a search sits on top. Take the policy's top twelve moves.
Look at six replies each, three plies deep, cutting branches that can't matter.
Score up to four hundred and thirty-two leaves with the value token.
Then back up the best line, watching for repetitions.

scenes.label: Elo gained after the first checkpoint that came from the search wrapper
scenes.say: So where does the strength come from? Of the five hundred and fifty-two rating points gained after the raw policy, four hundred and eight came from the search wrapper.

scenes.text: A policy-plus-value network is a search prior, and the search is where the strength comes out.
scenes.mark: the search is where the strength comes out
scenes.say: A policy-plus-value network is a search prior. The search is where the strength comes out.

recap: One token per move, 1,968 in all
Value first, then moves, then the legal mask
Search on top adds most of the Elo
scenes.say: To recap: one token per move, a value before every move, and a search that adds most of the strength.
